announcements.text: BAE Systems Inc., Rockville, Maryland, is awarded a $99,206,056 hybrid cost-plus-fixed-fee and cost-plus-incentive-fee contract (N0003026C3033) to provide systems engineering and integration support services for Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Strategic Systems Programs (SSP). This contract provides supporting systems engineering, integration, technical information, fleet-support, program-management, cybersecurity, documentation, and related support-service requirements. This award also benefits a Foreign Military Sale. Work will be performed in Rockville, Maryland (61%); Washington, D.C. (20%); Cape Canaveral, Florida (4%); Saint Mary's, Georgia (2%); Silverdale, Washington (1%); Groton, Connecticut (1%); Frederick, Maryland (1%); North Kingstown, Rhode Island (1%); York, Pennsylvania (1%); Huntsville, Alabama (1%); Barrow-in-Furness, United Kingdom (1%); and various other locations under 1% each (6%). Efforts are expected to be completed Sept. 30, 2027. Fiscal 2025 One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) funds in the amount of $4,832,638 will be obligated upon award. No funds will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was awarded as a sole-source acquisition pursuant to 10 U.S. Code 2304(c)(1) and was previously synopsized on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) online portal. PAE SSP, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Northrop Grumman Corp., Charlottesville, Virginia, was awarded a $29,219,125 cost-plus-incentive-fee, cost-plus-fixed-fee, firm-fixed-price, and cost only contract for low-rate initial production units and maintenance assistance modules, engineering support, integration, and test of the AN/WSN-12 Inertial Navigation System and other direct costs, travel and material. This contract includes options which, if exercised, would bring the cumulative value of this contract to $103,629,832. This contract combines purchases for the Navy (27%); and the governments of Canada (42%), and Australia (31%), under the Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program. Work will be performed in Charlottesville, Virginia (90%); and Baltimore, Maryland (10%), and is expected to be completed by May 2030. If all options are exercised, work will continue through July 2032. FMS (Canada) funds in the amount of $12,271,012 (42%); FMS (Australia) funds in the amount of $9,203,260 (31%); fiscal 2026 other procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $4,677,100 (16%); and fiscal 2024 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) funds in the amount of $3,067,753 (11%), were obligated at the time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was not competitively procured in accordance with 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(1) (only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements). Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity (N00024-26-C-5207). (Awarded Sept. 30, 2026).

announcements.text: Serco Inc. Herndon, Virginia, was awarded a ceiling $49,000,000 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (FA8681-27-D-B001) with a delivery order with a total value of $1,328,572 (FA8681-27-F-B004) for technical analytics and transition support. announcements.text: American Systems Corp., McLean, Virginia, has been awarded a $43,266,824 firm fixed price task order for Red LAN Sustainment. This contract provides for the continued operations and maintenance of the Red Local Area Network (Red LAN) System and Red LAN System Data Provider/Data Recipient additions. Work will be performed at Schriever Space Force Base, Colorado, and is expected to be completed by September 29, 2031. This award is the result of a competitive acquisition and 16 offers were received. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $2,001,232 are being obligated at the time of award. The Space Systems Command, Peterson Space Force Base, Colorado, is the contracting activity (FA8821-26-F-B015).

announcements.text: Vision Quest Solutions Inc., Rapid City, South Dakota, has been awarded a $25,274,553 firm-fixed-price, single award contract for Fire Protection and Emergency Services. This contract provides for the contractor to furnish all labor, tools, materials, equipment, supervision, personnel and all else necessary to manage and accomplish 24-hour 7 days a week fire protection and emergency services. Work will be performed at Cavalier Space Force Station, North Dakota, and is expected to be completed by Oct. 31, 2031. This contract was a competitive 100% small business set aside acquisition and seven offers were received. Fiscal 2027 operation and maintenance funds in the amount of $5,117,556 will be obligated for the base year. The 319th Contracting Squadron, Grand Forks Air Force Base, North Dakota, is the contracting activity (FA465926C0002).

announcements.text: Goodwill Industries of San Antonio Contract Services, San Antonio, Texas, has been awarded a $24,480,799 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/requirements contract for Grounds Maintenance Services. This contract provides for all personnel, equipment, tools, supervision, and other items and services necessary to perform installation-wide grounds maintenance services, to include the growth of healthy grass, trees, and shrubs. Work will be performed at Joint Base San Antonio-Lackland, Texas, and is expected to be completed by Feb. 28, 2031. This award is the result of an AbilityOne sole source acquisition. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $1,908,802 are being obligated at the time of award. The 502d Contracting Squadron, Joint Base San Antonio-Lackland, Texas, is the contracting activity (FA301627D0002).

announcements.text: Venetic Inc., Miami, Florida, has been awarded a $9,950,000 firm-fixed-price contract to modernize the TPS-70 radar system to a solid-state environment. This contract provides for the modernization of the Mexico Air Force's radar systems and for the purchase of a virtual environment to share real-time data with the Southwest Command. Work will be performed at Miami, Florida; and Hermosillo, Mexico, and is expected to be completed by Sept. 28, 2029. This contract involves Foreign Military Sales to Mexico. This contract was a sole source acquisition. Fiscal 2026 Building Partner Capacity funds in the amount of $9,950,000 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Hanscom Air Force Base, Massachusetts, is the contracting activity (FA238-26-C-B003).
